csv_project_name: Consultant for 7th Housing Cycle Housing Element
csv_scope_of_work: REQUEST FOR QUALIFICATIONS/PROPOSALS (RFQ/RFP) FOR CONSULTANT SERVICES. Scope of Services Below are the tasks expected to be performed by the selected Consultant: Prepare the City s 7th Cycle Housing Element in collaboration with and at the direction of City staff (estimated for adoption in 2029/2030). Lead public participation processes, document them, and incorporate them into the Housing Element. Update the City s existing Housing Needs Assessment, Housing Constraints Assessment, Housing Resources Assessment, Housing Plan, Affirmatively Furthering Fair Housing Assessment, and Housing Element Sites Inventory in collaboration with City staff. When required, attend all project hearings before the Planning Commission and City Council, and public workshops. Act as a liaison between City staff and the Department of Housing and Community Development (HCD) by submitting and coordinating HCD s review of the City s Housing Element. Prepare updates to other elements of the General Plan as required. Prepare related studies or documents as part of the Housing Element update. Complete any other tasks reasonably related to the 7th Cycle Housing Element at the direction of City staff.
csv_disciplines_requested: Housing & Urban Development, Planning/Master Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design
